name: Ataroth
overview: Ataroth is identified in Scripture as a name for several cities located east of the Jordan River and within the tribal territories of Ephraim, Judah, and Gad. The children of Gad are noted for building Ataroth along with other cities east of Jordan, highlighting its role in the settlement of Israel’s tribes (Numbers 32:3, 34-35). In Ephraim, Ataroth marks a boundary in the inheritance allotment, while in Judah it is referred to as Atroth-beth-joab, indicating its distinct identity within that tribe’s territory (Joshua 16:2, 5, 7). These references underscore Ataroth’s significance as a geographical and tribal landmark in the Old Testament narrative.
